Based on my research of the CIA World Factbook regarding South American space agencies, here is the answer to your question:

## Coastal South American Countries with Space Agencies Established Before 2000:

According to the CIA World Factbook records, **two** coastal South American countries established formal space agencies before the year 2000:

| Country | Agency Name | Establishment Date | Location |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|----------|
| **Argentina** | National Space Activities Commission (CONAE) | May 28, 1991 | Atlantic Ocean |
| **Brazil** | Brazilian Space Agency (AEB) | February 10, 1994 | Atlantic Ocean |

## Other Coastal South American Countries:

Several other coastal South American countries do **not** have documented space agencies established before 2000 according to the CIA World Factbook:

- **Chile**: Established Chilean Space Agency (CSA) in 2001 (after 2000)
- **Ecuador**: Established Ecuadorian Civilian Space Agency (EXA) in 2007 (after 2000)
- **Venezuela**, **Colombia**, **Uruguay**, **Peru**, **Guyana**, and **Suriname**: No formal space agencies with pre-2000 establishment dates are documented in the CIA World Factbook

## Answer: **2 coastal South American countries** (Argentina and Brazil) established their space agencies before the year 2000 according to the CIA World Factbook.
